tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Who Schütze Capital is, key facts, who it serves, languages, and how to reach it (booking links, inquiry endpoints, privacy).

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The services Schütze Capital offers, who each is for, its page, and its published price or how pricing works.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Schütze Capital's published prices and terms, or an honest statement that it publishes none.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers Schütze Capital publishes to common questions.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send Schütze Capital a quote request on behalf of a person. Returns an automated acknowledgement and the booking link. Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Ask for a call with Schütze Capital for a person. Returns the self-service booking page and records the request so a person confirms a time. Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send Schütze Capital a question, partnership proposal or other inquiry on behalf of a person (intent field). Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.
